'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**Seven security forces and five [[Park ranger|rangers]] are killed during an [[ambush]] by [[Islamic extremism|Islamic extremists]] at the [[W National Park]] in [[Benin]]. The park is overrun by the militants. [https://apnews.com/article/benin-park-w-jihadi-violence-f3f1c6765ebc423c549e266e94f5d1bd (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Poland|Polish]] divers announce that they have discovered a 19th-century shipwreck in the [[Baltic Sea]] off the coast of [[Sweden]], containing crates of [[champagne]] and [[porcelain]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240724-champagne-filled-shipwreck-found-by-polish-divers (France 24)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Nasdaq Composite]] drops 654.94 points (-3.64%) on 24 July, marking its [[List of largest daily changes in the Nasdaq Composite|third-largest one-day point loss]]. The [[S&P 500]] drops 128.61 points (-2.31%) on the same day, marking its [[List of largest daily changes in the S&P 500 Index|fifteenth-largest one-day point loss]]. [https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-rates-inflation-3f4ccd479801d93e8472b831400c25fb (AP)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2024/07/23/stock-market-today-live-updates.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Gaemi]]
***[[Metro Manila]], [[Philippines]], is placed under a [[State of calamity (Philippines)|state of calamity]] due to [[flash flood]]s caused by [[Typhoon Gaemi]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-07-24/philippine-capital-region-placed-under-state-of-calamity-abs (Bloomberg)]
***Two people are killed and 266 others are injured by Typhoon Gaemi in northern [[Taiwan]] as the typhoon passes through [[Fujian province]], [[China]], and heads inland. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/typhoon-gaemi-passes-over-taiwan-heads-chinese-coast-2024-07-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Canadian wildfires]]
**[[2024 Jasper wildfire]]
***Two wildfires burning in [[Jasper National Park]] reach the [[Jasper, Alberta|Jasper townsite]] in [[Alberta]], causing several [[structure fire]]s, with over 25,000 residents evacuating their homes since Monday. [https://edmontonjournal.com/news/local-news/jasper-townsite-cleared-wildfire-evacuation (''Edmonton Journal'')]
**Air quality in [[Calgary]] and the surrounding areas are raised to "[[Air Quality Health Index (Canada)#Overview|high risk]]" as winds blow smoke into the region. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/calgary/calgary-air-quality-index-weather-1.7273432 (CBC News)]
*[[2024 Nouakchott migrant boat disaster]]
**Fifteen people are killed and more than 195 others are missing after a boat carrying [[African immigration to Europe|migrants]] capsizes near [[Nouakchott]], [[Mauritania]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/07/24/africa/mauritania-migrants-shipwreck-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2024 Saurya Airlines Bombardier CRJ200 crash]]
**A [[Bombardier CRJ100/200|Bombardier CRJ-200]] crashes during takeoff at [[Tribhuvan International Airport]] in [[Kathmandu]], [[Nepal]], killing eighteen people on board, with only the captain surviving. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/saurya-airlines-plane-crashes-during-takeoff-nepal-kathmandu-post-says-2024-07-24/ (Reuters)]
*Ten migrants are found drowned in a river near the [[Colombia–Panama border]], according to [[Panama]]nian [[National Border Service|border police]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/24/ten-people-drown-in-panama-river-as-migration-risks-escalate (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war protests in the United States]]
***[[July 2024 protest in Washington, D.C.]]
****A series of protests occur across [[Washington, D.C.]], to protest a speech given by [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] to a joint session of the [[United States Congress]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/thousands-protest-near-us-capitol-ahead-netanyahu-speech-2024-07-24/ (Reuters)] [https://www.nbcwashington.com/news/local/lift-the-siege-on-gaza-dc-sees-major-protests-road-closures-ahead-of-netanyahu-speech/3673551/ (WRC-TV)]
**[[Israel–United States relations]]
***Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addresses a [[Joint session of the United States Congress|joint session]] of the United States Congress amid [[Israel–Hamas war protests in the United States|protests]] over Israel's conduct of the [[Israel–Hamas war|war in Gaza]]. [https://apnews.com/live/harris-biden-trump-election-campaign-updates (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/protests-politics-israels-netanyahu-addresses-us-congress-2024-07-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[China–Russia relations]], [[China–United States relations]], [[Russia–United States relations]]
**The [[North American Aerospace Defense Command]] intercepts two [[Russia|Russian]] and two [[China|Chinese]] bomber aircraft flying together near [[Alaska]], marking the first record of Chinese [[Xi'an H-6|H-6 aircraft]] entering Alaska's [[Air Defense Identification Zone (North America)|Air Defense Identification Zone]], and marking the first time both countries were intercepted operating together. [https://cnn.com/2024/07/24/politics/norad-russian-chinese-bombers-alaska/index.html (CNN)] 
*[[Poland–Ukraine relations]], [[Ukraine–European Union relations]]
**[[Ministry of National Defence (Poland)|Polish Defense Minister]] [[Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz]] states that [[Poland]] will block [[Ukraine]]'s bid to join the [[European Union]] if it doesn't resolve issues regarding [[Ukrainian Insurgent Army|Ukrainian nationalists]]' [[Massacres of Poles in Volhynia and Eastern Galicia|massacre of Poles]] during [[World War II|WWII]], including finding and burying all victims killed on current Ukrainian territory. [https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-eu-volyn-poland/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Royal Commission of Inquiry into Abuse in Care]]
**A formal inquiry by the [[New Zealand government]] concludes that since 1950, about 200,000 people in state and religious care were [[abuse]]d, experiencing abuses such as [[rape]], [[Sterilization (medicine)|sterilization]], and [[electric shock]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/new-zealand-apologise-after-enquiry-finds-200000-children-vulnerable-adults-2024-07-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Germany|German]] [[Federal Ministry of the Interior (Germany)|Interior Minister]] [[Nancy Faeser]] closes the [[Islamic Centre Hamburg]] for allegedly propagating extremism and being a direct representative of [[Iran]]ian [[Supreme Leader of Iran|Supreme Leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]]. The Iranian [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Foreign Ministry]] summons the German ambassador following the closure. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-shuts-down-islamic-center-hamburg/a-69747298 (DW)]
*Three [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian soldiers]] are killed and four others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] after a dispute in [[Kharkiv Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/07/25/three-dead-in-shooting-incident-among-ukrainian-troops (Al Arabiya)]

'''Science and technology'''
*Researchers from the [[Scottish Association for Marine Science]] report evidence of [[dark oxygen]] being produced from metals on the [[seafloor]]. It was previously assumed that almost all the free oxygen ({{chem|O|2}}) on Earth was created through [[photosynthesis]], which requires sunlight. [https://www.npr.org/2024/07/24/nx-s1-5049587/scientists-dark-oxygen-without-photosynthesis (NPR)]

'''Sports'''
*[[142nd IOC Session]]
**At the [[International Olympic Committee]]'s meeting in [[Paris]], [[France]], it is announced that the [[French Alps]] region has been conditionally approved to host the [[2030 Winter Olympics]] and that [[Salt Lake City]], [[Utah]], [[United States]], will host the [[2034 Winter Olympics]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/sports/salt-lake-city-celebrates-announcement-winter-olympics-return-2034 (Fox News)] [https://apnews.com/article/winter-olympics-2030-france-alps-nice-ioc-e14c106194e303b5a2ffa968740650b0 (AP)]
*[[2024 Summer Olympics]]
**The [[Canadian Olympic Committee]] expels two members of the [[Canada women's national soccer team|women's soccer team]] coaching staff from the Olympics following a [[Concerns and controversies at the 2024 Summer Olympics#Canada women's football drone spying|spying incident]] involving a drone disrupting [[New Zealand women's national football team|New Zealand]]'s training session. [[FIFA]] initiates disciplinary proceedings. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/24/canadian-womens-football-staff-sent-home-from-olympics-over-drone-incident (Al Jazeera)]
